reviews.decision_reason: The selected output contains only the top scored record, but the supplied semantic package does not expose the threshold value or implementation. The boundary may be applying a valid threshold, but it may also be dropping otherwise relevant demand records without visible justification. The selected record preserves record_id/source_id/source_weight, so the exact returned handoff identifiers are visible for the one emitted record.

The normalized needs handoff in the supplied output preserves the allowed corpus identifiers and required demand fields for the selected record. No contradictory evidence is supplied for this boundary.

The provenance output contains the selected record_id, source_id, source_weight, and deterministic rank for the emitted need. This preserves the evidence_sources handoff needed downstream. The package does not show evidence of unrelated candidates or generic keyword expansion at this boundary.
